item.title: As I Lay Dying: 'We Are The Dead' Drops with Alex Terrible and Tom Barber; VIDEO
item.description: As I Lay Dying is gearing up to drop their latest album, Through Storms Ahead, set to land on November 15. Nestled among the tracks are “Burden,” “The Cave We Fear to Enter,” and the freshly unleashed “We Are The Dead.
